experiments.title: FFTW production baseline
experiments.question: Can the benchmark reproduce WVM's production FFTW configuration and the historical issue #129 workloads exactly?
experiments.baseline: This is the foundational raw-FFT baseline after the operator and representation contract in issue #2.

definition.unitOfWork: Batched two-dimensional real-to-complex or complex-to-real transforms over WVM horizontal planes.
definition.candidates: FFTW 3.3.11 guru64 plans using the production NEON, pthread, compiler, layout, and planning configuration.
definition.workloads: Historical 256 and 512 square cases plus current Nz=129/257 and fields=1/3/4 cases with production antialiasing metadata.
definition.controlledVariables: Fixtures, precision, mathematical normalization, WVM strides, compiler policy, sampling protocol, and machine-state protocol.
definition.changedVariables: Workload shape, field count, and worker count only.
definition.timedBoundary: The raw FFTW execution call; planning and allocation are separate setup measurements.
definition.excludedWork: Fixture generation, correctness evaluation, horizontal retention, layout conversion, vertical projection, modal work, and nonlinear flux.
definition.allocationPolicy: No allocation in the timed steady-state loop.

correctness.oracle: Independent mode-keyed direct-DFT oracle and inverse round trip.
correctness.tolerance: Float64 maximum scale-normalized error at most 1e-12.
correctness.capabilityHandling: Unsupported shapes or plan configurations are explicit capability results.
correctness.canSupport: A reproducible raw FFTW baseline for later strategy and retained-operator comparisons.
correctness.cannotSupport: A provider, layout, or complete-pipeline adoption decision by itself.

experiments.title: FFTW strategy sweep
experiments.question: Do FFTW planning, alignment, layout, or scheduling strategies improve on the production baseline without unacceptable setup or memory costs?
experiments.baseline: Compare every candidate with issue #3 and retain a Pareto set for issue #7.

definition.unitOfWork: The same full real-2-D transform batches as issue #3; layout increments may additionally preserve the provider representation through separately reported horizontal retention and embedding.
definition.candidates: Aligned and unaligned plans; ESTIMATE, MEASURE, PATIENT, and EXHAUSTIVE; wisdom; interleaved and split APIs; internal, outer, and hybrid threading.
definition.workloads: The production workload matrix established by issue #3.
definition.controlledVariables: Mathematical transforms, fixtures, precision, dimensions, sampling, compiler, and machine protocol.
definition.changedVariables: Planning effort, alignment, representation, wisdom state, and scheduling.
definition.timedBoundary: Raw provider execution is always reported separately from planning, allocation, wisdom, conversion, retained-mode selection or embedding, adapters, and persistent-layout totals.
definition.excludedWork: Vertical projection, modal work, and nonlinear flux; retention remains outside primitive FFT timing even when a layout increment reports it separately.
definition.allocationPolicy: No allocation in timed execution; all setup memory is reported.

correctness.oracle: The issue #2 full-spectrum oracle and issue #3 reference outputs.
correctness.tolerance: Float64 maximum scale-normalized error at most 1e-12.
correctness.capabilityHandling: Failed or unavailable plan/layout combinations remain visible.
correctness.canSupport: A setup/throughput/memory Pareto set for retained-horizontal testing.
correctness.cannotSupport: A complete retained-operator or pipeline winner.

experiments.title: vDSP native baseline
experiments.question: What are the correct raw and adapter costs of native split-complex vDSP real-2-D transforms relative to the production FFTW baseline?
experiments.baseline: Use issue #3 as the comparable full-transform baseline; supply candidates to issue #6 and issue #7.

definition.unitOfWork: Batched native vDSP real-2-D forward or inverse transforms and separately measured WVM-compatible adapters.
definition.candidates: In-place and out-of-place Float64 vDSP APIs, explicit reusable scratch buffers, and native packed split-complex storage.
definition.workloads: Power-of-two production cases matched to issue #3, with unsupported dimensions reported explicitly.
definition.controlledVariables: Logical transforms, fixtures, precision, workload, worker policy, normalization, and sampling protocol.
definition.changedVariables: Provider-native placement, scratch policy, and adapter path.
definition.timedBoundary: Raw vDSP execution, packing, unpacking, conversion, and complete adapter are independent measurements.
definition.excludedWork: Planning and allocation from execution, vertical projection, modal work, and nonlinear flux.
definition.allocationPolicy: Reusable native and scratch buffers; zero timed-loop allocation.

correctness.oracle: Independent mode-keyed oracle with explicit vDSP DC, Nyquist, normalization, and packing rules.
correctness.tolerance: Float64 maximum scale-normalized error at most 1e-12.
correctness.capabilityHandling: Unsupported shapes, placement modes, or storage contracts are explicit results rather than fallbacks.
correctness.canSupport: A trustworthy raw vDSP and WVM-adapter baseline.
correctness.cannotSupport: The best batching policy or complete retained-horizontal algorithm.

experiments.title: vDSP batching and scheduling
experiments.question: Can multiple-transform implementations or batch scheduling close the vDSP gap observed in issue #5?
experiments.baseline: Compare with issues #3, #4, and #5; pass viable vDSP configurations to issue #7.

definition.unitOfWork: A complete batch of independent horizontal real-2-D transforms.
definition.candidates: Direct 2-D calls; separable row/column multiple-transform calls; persistent thread pools; Grand Central Dispatch; per-worker setup.
definition.controlledVariables: Provider, precision, logical transforms, storage contract, fixtures, and sampling.
definition.changedVariables: Batch decomposition, worker count, setup sharing, scheduler, and transposition policy.
definition.timedBoundary: Native execution, scheduling, packing, transposition, and complete adapter are separate scopes.
definition.excludedWork: Vertical projection, modal work, and nonlinear flux.
definition.allocationPolicy: Persistent workers and buffers with no timed-loop allocation.

correctness.oracle: Issue #5 provider conformance and mode-keyed outputs.
correctness.tolerance: Float64 maximum scale-normalized error at most 1e-12.
correctness.capabilityHandling: Unavailable APIs and shapes are published as capability results.
correctness.canSupport: A vDSP scheduling Pareto set for issue #7.

experiments.title: Retained horizontal algorithms
experiments.question: Which correct algorithm computes the retained horizontal operator fastest when conversion and selection are optional algorithm choices?
experiments.baseline: Compose survivors from issues #4, #6, and #12; feed issue #13 and issue #9.

definition.unitOfWork: The retained operators P_h F_xy and F_xy^-1 E_h identified by logical mode key.
definition.candidates: Full transform plus selection, index views, fused selection/conversion, persistent provider order, and viable pruned transforms.
definition.workloads: Production antialiased dimensions and fields from the provider baseline issues.
definition.controlledVariables: Retained modes, fixtures, precision, mathematical normalization, and sampling.
definition.changedVariables: Provider, representation/order, selection or embedding algorithm, fusion, placement, and scheduling.
definition.timedBoundary: Raw FFTs remain separate; retained-operator components, adapters, and uninstrumented totals are all published.
definition.excludedWork: Vertical projection, modal work, and nonlinear flux.
definition.allocationPolicy: No timed-loop allocation; persistent representation memory is explicit.

correctness.oracle: Independent retained-mode oracle keyed by horizontal wavenumber and field/vertical index.
correctness.tolerance: Float64 maximum scale-normalized error at most 1e-12.
correctness.capabilityHandling: A native layout may be correct without canonical conversion; unsupported algorithms remain visible.
correctness.canSupport: Retained-horizontal winners by workload and storage contract.
correctness.cannotSupport: The downstream ordering/GEMM crossover or complete pipeline winner.

experiments.title: Vertical projection and split-complex GEMM
experiments.question: Which primitive and split-complex GEMM strategy is fastest for the antialiased vertical projection independently of horizontal layout?
experiments.baseline: Establish the vertical-kernel baseline used by issue #13 and issue #9.

definition.unitOfWork: Forward (Nj by Nz)(Nz by K) and inverse (Nz by Nj)(Nj by K) vertical projections.
definition.candidates: Complex GEMM, two split real GEMMs, grouped/batched variants, blocked kernels, and prepared matrix families.
definition.workloads: Nz=65/129/257, Nj=floor(2(Nz-1)/3), K=Nkl times fields, common and K-squared-grouped matrices.
definition.controlledVariables: Matrix values, logical column keys, precision, dimensions, and sampling protocol.
definition.changedVariables: Complex representation, GEMM strategy, grouping, blocking, and Accelerate thread setting.
definition.timedBoundary: Primitive GEMM excludes packing and matrix preparation; those costs are reported separately.
definition.excludedWork: Horizontal FFTs, input packing from horizontal representations, modal work, and nonlinear flux.
definition.allocationPolicy: Preallocated operands and outputs with zero timed-loop allocation.

correctness.oracle: Independent Float64 matrix products in logical mode order.
correctness.tolerance: Float64 scale-normalized and relative L2 errors at most the preregistered 1e-12 contract.
correctness.capabilityHandling: Unsupported grouped or batched APIs are explicit results.
correctness.cannotSupport: Whether data packing or a complete spectral pipeline is worthwhile.

experiments.title: Combined spectral pipeline
experiments.question: Which complete synthetic spectral-operator graph is fastest after composing the best horizontal, vertical, and ordering policies?
experiments.baseline: Compose reference candidates from issues #7, #8, and #13; provide primary evidence to issue #11.

definition.unitOfWork: Horizontal forward, vertical forward, representative modal work, vertical inverse, and horizontal inverse.
definition.candidates: Complete interleaved, split, provider-native, reordered, tiled, and fused algorithm graphs.
definition.workloads: Representative production antialiased horizontal and vertical shapes with fields=1/3/4.
definition.controlledVariables: Mathematical operator, fixtures, retained modes, precision, and sampling protocol.
definition.changedVariables: Provider, horizontal algorithm, representation/order, vertical kernel, packing, fusion, placement, and scheduling.
definition.timedBoundary: A separately measured uninstrumented end-to-end steady-state iteration plus a diagnostic component ledger.
definition.excludedWork: WVM nonlinear flux, time integration, model state management, I/O, and correctness evaluation.
definition.allocationPolicy: Zero allocations in the timed pipeline; all persistent and peak memory reported.

correctness.oracle: Independent horizontal-and-vertical projection keyed by (k,l,j,field) plus complete round-trip equivalence.
correctness.tolerance: Float64 maximum scale-normalized error at most 1e-12.
correctness.capabilityHandling: Fused stages are marked fused and unsupported graphs remain visible.
correctness.canSupport: The primary synthetic-pipeline evidence for a WVM integration candidate.
correctness.cannotSupport: Scientific equivalence inside the full nonlinear WVM calculation.

experiments.title: KFR and DUCC provider screen
experiments.question: Can KFR or DUCC beat the stable retained-horizontal baseline on relevant Apple-Silicon workloads?
experiments.baseline: Compare optional providers with issue #7 without blocking v1.

definition.unitOfWork: Raw real-2-D FFTs and the complete retained-horizontal operator.
definition.candidates: KFR and DUCC behind the provider-independent logical operator contract.
definition.workloads: Power-of-two, rectangular, and representative non-power-of-two cases.
definition.controlledVariables: Fixtures, precision, logical retained modes, compiler, and sampling.
definition.changedVariables: Provider, supported shape, representation, placement, and adapter.
definition.timedBoundary: Raw provider calls and retained-operator totals are separate.
definition.excludedWork: Vertical projection, complete pipeline, nonlinear flux, and dependency build time from execution.
definition.allocationPolicy: No allocation in timed steady state.

correctness.oracle: Issue #2 full and retained mode-keyed oracles.
correctness.capabilityHandling: Provider exclusions are published without fallback.
correctness.canSupport: A decision to promote an optional provider into deeper experiments.

experiments.title: Pruned horizontal transforms
experiments.question: Can an algorithm that computes only retained horizontal modes beat full-transform FFTW or vDSP baselines?
experiments.baseline: Compare with issues #3 and #5; feed viable or negative results to issue #7.

definition.unitOfWork: Forward retained-mode computation and inverse reconstruction without requiring a materialized full half-spectrum.
definition.candidates: Pruned, implicitly de-aliased, fused transform-selection, and feasibility-bound algorithms.
definition.workloads: WVM production dimensions, fields=1/3/4, and power-of-two cases.
definition.controlledVariables: Logical retained modes, fixtures, precision, correctness oracle, and sampling.
definition.changedVariables: Pruning algorithm, fusion, representation, placement, and scheduling.
definition.timedBoundary: The inseparable retained transform is timed honestly; full provider FFTs remain separate baselines.
definition.excludedWork: Vertical projection, modal work, nonlinear flux, and feasibility-analysis setup from steady-state execution.
definition.allocationPolicy: No timed-loop allocation; tables and scratch memory reported.

correctness.oracle: Independent retained-mode forward and inverse oracle.
correctness.tolerance: Float64 maximum scale-normalized error at most 1e-12.
correctness.capabilityHandling: A reproducible negative feasibility result satisfies the experiment when no candidate can compete.
correctness.canSupport: Promotion or rejection of pruned candidates for issue #7.
correctness.cannotSupport: A complete pipeline decision without vertical and movement experiments.

experiments.title: Ordering and packing crossover
experiments.question: When does optional reordering between horizontal transforms and vertical projections repay its movement cost?
experiments.baseline: Cross issue #7 horizontal candidates with issue #8 vertical kernels; feed complete policies to issue #9.

definition.unitOfWork: Transfer retained modes into a vertical projection and back, including only movement required by each candidate policy.
definition.candidates: No reorder, MATLAB gather/transpose/radial order, pre-permuted matrices, fused conversion, tiled pack-and-GEMM, and persistent compact layouts.
definition.workloads: Reference horizontal cases crossed with Nz=65/129/257, retained Nj, fields=1/3/4, matrix families, and reuse counts.
definition.controlledVariables: Logical modes, vertical operator, fixtures, precision, and total mathematical work.
definition.changedVariables: Physical order, packing/fusion, matrix preparation, tiling, persistence, direction, and reuse count.
definition.timedBoundary: Primitive GEMM, packing, combined packing-plus-GEMM, setup, and reuse-sequence totals are separate.
definition.excludedWork: Raw FFT execution except inseparable fusion, modal physics, nonlinear flux, and correctness evaluation.
definition.allocationPolicy: Zero allocations in steady state; persistent, scratch, and prepared-matrix memory reported.

correctness.oracle: Independent mode-keyed horizontal-and-vertical projection with permutation-invariance checks.
correctness.tolerance: Float64 maximum scale-normalized error at most 1e-12.
correctness.capabilityHandling: Shape-, machine-, and direction-specific results are permitted and exclusions remain visible.
correctness.canSupport: Movement and reuse crossover policies for issue #9.
correctness.cannotSupport: A universal required physical order or complete pipeline winner.

experiments.baseline: Pair with the stable Float64 experiments from issues #3, #5, #7, #8, #13, and #9 without blocking v1.

definition.unitOfWork: The same antialiased FFT, vertical projection, and synthetic pipeline as the Float64 reference experiments.
definition.candidates: FFTW float APIs, Float32 vDSP, complex and split-real GEMM, and retained algorithms that support Float32.
definition.workloads: Paired Float32/Float64 production shapes, fields, vertical retention, and scheduling sweeps.
definition.controlledVariables: Logical operator, fixture scaling, retained modes, planning effort, worker policy, and sampling.
definition.changedVariables: Precision, provider, representation, placement, packing, vertical kernel, batching, and scheduling.
definition.timedBoundary: Raw FFT, raw GEMM, movement, adapters, and uninstrumented totals are separate.
definition.excludedWork: Fixture generation, oracle evaluation, report generation, WVM nonlinear flux, and model-level validation.
